messages:
maya: FYI customer is hitting 500s when invoking /v1/call for function 'submit_order'. They say our runtime returns an "Invalid JSON" parse error even though payload looks JSON.
raj: Can you paste the raw request they sent (headers + body)?
maya: Pasting sanitized curl from customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/call \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-llm-02",
    "function": "submit_order",
    "arguments": "{\"order_id\":\"ord-123\",\"items\":\"[\"sku1\",\"sku2\"]\" }"
  }'
```
maya: Note: customer is double-stringifying the arguments field and 'items' inside is a stringified array. Their declared function schema requires a top-level string sessionId and items array.
sam: That double-encode will land as a string in our parser. Runtime tries to validate against schema and fails.
raj: Got runtime logs from staging for a repro request:
```
ERROR validate_function_call args_validation.go:47 "validation error: missing required key 'sessionId'"
ERROR parse jsonparser.go:112 "json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type []interface{} for path arguments.items"
```
maya: Customer reported 500s, but some requests were 401 earlier — they said occasional proxy dropped Authorization header. Could be unrelated but worth noting.
elaine: I repro'd locally by copying their curl and got:
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"function argument validation failed","details":["missing required key 'sessionId'","type mismatch at arguments.items: expected array got string"]}
raj: Root cause: SDK/client is serializing the "arguments" object to a JSON string before sending. Our runtime expects the HTTP body to have arguments as an object, not a string. When combined with missing sessionId, validation fails with a 400 which customer sees as a 500 in their app.
maya: Customer is on Dedicated; they're seeing flaky 500s in production. They want urgent fix and a repro to send to their security team.
sam: Short-term mitigation: we can be more lenient in parsing — detect stringified JSON in "arguments" and attempt to parse it. But that could mask client bugs.
raj: Action items:
- [maya] ask customer to resend with arguments as JSON object and include sessionId (one-line sample below)
- [raj] build minimal repro harness and unit test to catch stringified-arguments case
- [sam] check ingress proxies in their VPC for header-stripping (Authorization) and confirm no auth path issues
- [elaine] open INC-2026 and assign to runtime team (priority P1 if customer is blocking)

maya: sample correct payload to forward to customer:
```
{
  "model": "rwd-llm-02",
  "function": "submit_order",
  "arguments": {
    "sessionId": "sesh-789",
    "order_id": "ord-123",
    "items": ["sku1","sku2"]
  }
}
```
raj: Also requested: full raw request + response pair and the customer's SDK version. Customer said they use a forked JS SDK that stringifies args.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2026 at 1712350000 assigned to runtime-team.
billing-bot: No billing impact noted; will monitor if retries spike.
maya: Escalating to runtime-team, will update customer with repro steps and temporary guidance to stop stringifying arguments. :rotating_light:
raj: If runtime-team agrees, I'll prototype tolerant parsing and we can evaluate risk of deploying to Dedicated clusters as a hotfix.
maya: Thanks — I'll ping again once customer confirms they tested the corrected payload
